notes: Basic (standard) shroud configuration: room-temperature objective (max. outer diameter 36 mm) looks down through a single 25 mm fused-silica top window; cold shield lid adjustable for a 3.5 mm minimum working distance; lid carries 88x M6 holes on a 12.5 mm grid and 30/60 mm cage threads; feedthrough ring with blind flanges included (DC/SMA/fiber optional); not compatible with positioners. Base temp 3.5-3.8 K per shroud page, 3.8-320 K per spec sheet; cooldown < 4.5 h to 5 K; cooling power > 170 mW @ 5 K; vibration < 5 nm p-p vertical. Pulse-tube identification and the 1 Hz valve rate come from Vadia et al., PRX Quantum 2, 040318 (2021) (arXiv:2103.05619, co-authored by attocube), which also reports '1 Hz periodic pattern of mechanical pulses characteristic of closed-cycle coolers'; attocube's own pages only call it a 'closed-cycle cryostat' with 'cryocooler assembly ... underneath'. Permanent-magnet shroud exists as a custom option only; no magnet in this configuration.
